modules.title: 你會游泳嗎？
modules.title_py: Nǐ huì yóu yǒng ma?
modules.title_id: Can you swim?
modules.scene: The first week of university. By the campus pool, Meimei and Dawen ask each other which sports they can do and agree to train together, but the next day Meimei's foot hurts.
can_do: Say which sports I can and can't do (我會…／我不會…)
Explain why you can't exercise today (我的腳很痛，不能…)
Arrange to do sport together: day, time, meeting place
modules.exam_link: Sports & hobbies are a FREQUENT topic in TOCFL Band A: 聽力 Part 1 (pictures of sports) and Part 2. The difference between 會 and 能 is often used as a distractor in 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，你會游泳嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ huì yóu yǒng ma?
lines.id: Dawen, can you swim?

lines.zh: 會，我很喜歡游泳。學校的游泳池很大，我常常來游。你呢？
lines.py: Huì, wǒ hěn xǐ huān yóu yǒng. Xué xiào de yóu yǒng chí hěn dà, wǒ cháng cháng lái yóu. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: Yes, I love swimming. The campus pool is big; I often come here to swim. And you?

lines.zh: 我不會游泳，可是我會打網球。
lines.py: Wǒ bú huì yóu yǒng, kě shì wǒ huì dǎ wǎng qiú.
lines.id: I can't swim, but I can play tennis.

lines.zh: 我不會打網球，我會踢足球，也會打籃球。
lines.py: Wǒ bú huì dǎ wǎng qiú, wǒ huì tī zú qiú, yě huì dǎ lán qiú.
lines.id: I can't play tennis; I can play football, and basketball too.

lines.zh: 臺灣人很喜歡棒球，你會打棒球嗎？
lines.py: Tái wān rén hěn xǐ huān bàng qiú, nǐ huì dǎ bàng qiú ma?
lines.id: Taiwanese people love baseball. Can you play baseball?

lines.zh: 不會，可是我想學。你每天運動嗎？
lines.py: Bú huì, kě shì wǒ xiǎng xué. Nǐ měi tiān yùn dòng ma?
lines.id: No, but I'd like to learn. Do you exercise every day?

lines.zh: 對，我每天早上慢跑。
lines.py: Duì, wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng màn pǎo.
lines.id: Yes, I jog every morning.

lines.zh: 我也喜歡跑步！明天下午我們一起去跑步，好不好？
lines.py: Wǒ yě xǐ huān pǎo bù! Míng tiān xià wǔ wǒ men yì qǐ qù pǎo bù, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.id: I like running too! Let's go running together tomorrow afternoon, OK?

lines.zh: 好！
lines.py: Hǎo!
lines.id: Sure!

dialogs.title_id: The next day, a phone call

lines.zh: 大文，對不起，今天我不能去跑步，我的腳很痛。
lines.py: Dà wén, duì bù qǐ, jīn tiān wǒ bù néng qù pǎo bù, wǒ de jiǎo hěn tòng.
lines.id: Dawen, sorry, I can't go running today; my foot hurts.

lines.zh: 你的腳很痛，不能跑。你應該多休息。
lines.py: Nǐ de jiǎo hěn tòng, bù néng pǎo. Nǐ yīng gāi duō xiū xí.
lines.id: Your foot hurts, so you can't run. You should rest a lot.

lines.zh: 謝謝。星期六我能去。
lines.py: Xiè xie. Xīng qī liù wǒ néng qù.
lines.id: Thanks. I can go on Saturday.

lines.zh: 好！星期六早上七點，學校門口見，怎麼樣？
lines.py: Hǎo! Xīng qī liù zǎo shàng qī diǎn, xué xiào mén kǒu jiàn, zěn me yàng?
lines.id: OK! Saturday at seven in the morning, meet at the campus gate, how's that?

lines.zh: 好！我們先跑步，然後你教我游泳吧！
lines.py: Hǎo! Wǒ men xiān pǎo bù, rán hòu nǐ jiāo wǒ yóu yǒng ba!
lines.id: OK! We'll run first, and then you teach me to swim!

tasks.why: 慢跑 = jogging. 游泳 = swimming; 打籃球 = playing basketball.

tasks.question: 我們去做什麼？
tasks.why: 踢足球 = to play football (the verb is 踢, not 打). 棒球 = baseball; 網球 = tennis.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: A 會…嗎 question is answered 會／不會. B is on the same theme (water) but does not answer. C mentions 游泳池 but answers 'where', not 'can or can't'.

tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: 會…嗎 → answer 會/不會. B has the wrong order; C does not answer.

lines.zh: 你明天能跟我去打網球嗎？
明天不能，我的手很痛。
那星期天呢？
星期天可以。

tasks.question: 這位小姐什麼時候能去打網球？
tasks.why: Tomorrow his hand hurts (不能); Sunday is 可以. 明天 is a trap because it is mentioned first.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 你會踢足球嗎？星期六我們一起去踢吧！
我會踢，可是我的腳不舒服，這個星期不能踢。

tasks.question: 這位小姐的意思是什麼？
tasks.why: She CAN (會) play, but this week she CAN'T (不能) because of her foot. A = misreading 會/能 (the main trap). C reverses the meaning. D is not mentioned in the dialogue.

tasks.why: 游泳池 = swimming pool.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: Baseball = 棒球, with the verb 打.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 我的腳很痛，今天不（　）打籃球。
tasks.why: 能 = can because of a CONDITION (a sore foot). 會 = an ability that has been learned — he still "會" play basketball.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我叫王大文，我很喜歡運動。我（1）游泳，也會打籃球。每天早上，我去學校的（2）游泳。星期六，我常常跟朋友（3）足球。可是這個星期我的腳很痛，（4）踢。我想，星期六應該（5）去。
tasks.why: (1) a learned ability → 會. (2) a place to swim → 游泳池. (3) 踢足球. (4) the condition of a sore foot → 不能. (5) expecting to recover → 能. 籃球 doesn't fit any blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 李小姐會打網球，也會游泳，可是她不會踢足球。她每天早上跑步，星期六去游泳。
tasks.question: 哪一個是對的？
tasks.why: Text: 星期六去游泳. A and D reverse the meaning; B mixes up details (every day is 跑步, not 游泳).

grammar.explain: 會 = knowing how to do something because you have learned/practised it (languages, sports, instruments). The negative is 不會. To ask: 你會…嗎？ or 你會不會…？ A short answer is just 會。／不會。

examples.id: I can play tennis.
Can you play baseball?

examples.zh: 我不會游泳，可是我想學。
examples.id: I can't swim, but I'd like to learn.

check.q: Choose the right word: 我＿＿踢足球，我常常踢。

grammar.explain: 能 = whether you can or can't because of the CONDITIONS at the time (body, time, circumstances). Compare: 我會游泳 (I know how) ≠ 我今天不能游泳 (I know how, but today I can't for some reason).

examples.id: My foot hurts, I can't run.

examples.zh: 明天下午你能跟我去慢跑嗎？
examples.id: Can you go jogging with me tomorrow afternoon?

check.q: 美美會游泳，可是今天她的手很痛，今天她＿＿游泳。

core.meaning: to kick (踢足球 = to play football)

modules.title: 週末你想做什麼？
modules.title_py: Zhōu mò nǐ xiǎng zuò shén me?
modules.title_id: What are you doing at the weekend?
modules.scene: The campus is holding a weekend picnic. Meimei invites Dawen; in the park they take photos and listen to a teacher telling the children a story.
can_do: Express wishes with 想 (soft) and 要 (firm)
Invite someone to an activity and respond to invitations
Name weekend activities: 野餐、照相、聽音樂
modules.exam_link: Weekend plans & invitations are classic material for 聽力 Parts 3–4: questions often ask whether someone CAN/WANTS to come, with a hidden reason.

lines.zh: 大文，這個星期六你有空嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, zhè ge xīng qī liù nǐ yǒu kòng ma?
lines.id: Dawen, are you free this Saturday?

lines.zh: 有空。你想做什麼？
lines.py: Yǒu kòng. Nǐ xiǎng zuò shén me?
lines.id: Yes. What do you want to do?

lines.zh: 學校有一個活動，大家一塊兒去公園野餐。你要不要參加？
lines.py: Xué xiào yǒu yí ge huó dòng, dà jiā yí kuàir qù gōng yuán yě cān. Nǐ yào bú yào cān jiā?
lines.id: The school has an event; everyone is going to the park together for a picnic. Do you want to join?

lines.zh: 要！我要參加。我可以帶什麼？
lines.py: Yào! Wǒ yào cān jiā. Wǒ kě yǐ dài shén me?
lines.id: Yes! I'll join. What can I bring?

lines.zh: 你帶喝的吧，我要帶水果。
lines.py: Nǐ dài hē de ba, wǒ yào dài shuǐ guǒ.
lines.id: You bring drinks; I'll bring fruit.

lines.zh: 好！我也要照相！
lines.py: Hǎo! Wǒ yě yào zhào xiàng!
lines.id: OK! I want to take photos too!

lines.zh: 這裡好漂亮！美美，我給你照相吧。
lines.py: Zhè lǐ hǎo piào liàng! Měi měi, wǒ gěi nǐ zhào xiàng ba.
lines.id: It's so pretty here! Meimei, let me take your photo.

lines.zh: 好！……我想看那張相片。
lines.py: Hǎo!…… Wǒ xiǎng kàn nà zhāng xiàng piàn.
lines.id: OK! …I want to see that photo.

lines.zh: 你看，很好看吧！
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, hěn hǎo kàn ba!
lines.id: Look, it's nice, right?

lines.zh: 很好看！你看那邊，孩子們在畫圖。
lines.py: Hěn hǎo kàn! Nǐ kàn nà biān, hái zi men zài huà tú.
lines.id: Really nice! Look over there, the children are drawing.

lines.zh: 那位老師給他們說故事。
lines.py: Nà wèi lǎo shī gěi tā men shuō gù shì.
lines.id: That teacher is telling them a story.

lines.zh: 我也想聽故事！走，我們一塊兒去聽吧！
lines.py: Wǒ yě xiǎng tīng gù shì! Zǒu, wǒ men yí kuàir qù tīng ba!
lines.id: I want to hear the story too! Come on, let's go and listen together!

tasks.why: 星期六晚上聽音樂. 野餐 = Saturday morning; 故事 = Sunday afternoon; 照相 is not mentioned.

grammar.explain: 想 + verb = to want/hope to do something. It sounds softer than 要. A polite refusal: 我不想去 (I don't want to go).

examples.id: I'd like to take part in this event.
What would you like to do?

check.q: 'I don't want to watch a film' =

grammar.explain: 要 = to want (more definite than 想). 你要不要…？ = do you want to …? (an invitation). Careful: 不要 + V usually means 'don't' (learned in B05); for 'don't want to' it is safer to use 不想.

examples.id: Do you want to come with me?
OK! I want to go!

modules.title: 我們去看比賽吧！
modules.title_py: Wǒ men qù kàn bǐ sài ba!
modules.title_id: Let's go and watch a match!
modules.scene: Dawen wants to watch his first baseball game in Taiwan. They buy tickets early, then at the stadium they cheer for the team currently in second place.
can_do: Give order/rank with 第 (第一次、第二名)
Say you are going somewhere to do something (到球場去看比賽)
Cheer someone on: 加油！
modules.exam_link: Ordinal numbers (第一/第二) and tickets/prices often appear in 聽力 Part 1 and 閱讀 Part 3. 第一次 vs 一次 is a common distractor.

lines.zh: 美美，這個星期天有棒球比賽，我想到球場去看。
lines.py: Měi měi, zhè ge xīng qī tiān yǒu bàng qiú bǐ sài, wǒ xiǎng dào qiú chǎng qù kàn.
lines.id: Meimei, there's a baseball game this Sunday; I want to go to the stadium to watch it.

lines.zh: 好！我也要去。門票多少錢？
lines.py: Hǎo! Wǒ yě yào qù. Mén piào duō shǎo qián?
lines.id: Sure! I want to go too. How much are the tickets?

lines.zh: 一張票三百塊。這是我第一次看棒球比賽！
lines.py: Yì zhāng piào sān bǎi kuài. Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì kàn bàng qiú bǐ sài!
lines.id: Three hundred a ticket. This is my first time watching baseball!

lines.zh: 星期天人很多，我們早一點到球場去買票吧。
lines.py: Xīng qī tiān rén hěn duō, wǒ men zǎo yì diǎn dào qiú chǎng qù mǎi piào ba.
lines.id: It's crowded on Sundays; let's get to the stadium early to buy tickets.

lines.zh: 加油！加油！
lines.py: Jiā yóu! Jiā yóu!
lines.id: Come on! Go, go, go!

lines.zh: 他們現在是第幾名？
lines.py: Tā men xiàn zài shì dì jǐ míng?
lines.id: What place are they in now?

lines.zh: 第二名。今天他們能拿第一名！
lines.py: Dì èr míng. Jīn tiān tā men néng ná dì yī míng!
lines.id: Second place. Today they can take first place!

lines.zh: 加油！加油！
lines.py: Jiā yóu! Jiā yóu!
lines.id: Come on! Go, go, go!

lines.zh: 你聽，大家的加油聲好大！
lines.py: Nǐ tīng, dà jiā de jiā yóu shēng hǎo dà!
lines.id: Listen, everyone's cheering is so loud!

lines.zh: 他們真棒！這一場比賽很好看。
lines.py: Tā men zhēn bàng! Zhè yì chǎng bǐ sài hěn hǎo kàn.
lines.id: They're great! This game is really exciting.

lines.zh: 下次我們再到球場來看吧！
lines.py: Xià cì wǒ men zài dào qiú chǎng lái kàn ba!
lines.id: Let's come to the stadium again next time!

lines.zh: 好！下一場我也要來！
lines.py: Hǎo! Xià yì chǎng wǒ yě yào lái!
lines.id: OK! I want to come to the next game too!

tasks.question: 兩個學生，門票一共多少錢？
tasks.why: 2 × 150 = 300. 三百 is also the price of one regular ticket — a number distractor that 'happens' to match; calculate from the student price.

grammar.explain: Put 第 before a number for order: 第一 (first), 第二名 (second place), 第一次 (the first time). To ask: 第幾？ (which number).

examples.zh: 這是我第一次看棒球比賽。
examples.id: This is my first time watching baseball.
What place are they in now?

grammar.point: 到…去/來 + VP — go to … to …
grammar.pattern: S + 到 + place + 去/來 + activity
grammar.explain: The place sits between 到 … 去 (moving away) or 到 … 來 (towards the speaker), followed by the activity done there.

examples.id: Let's go to the stadium to watch!

examples.zh: 星期天我要到學校去看比賽。
examples.id: On Sunday I'm going to campus to watch a match.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 14
note: 去 or 來 depends on where the SPEAKER is: 她去學校 = 她到學校去 (the speaker is not at school); 他來臺灣 = 他到臺灣來 (the speaker is in Taiwan).
Three forms with the same meaning: 她去學校上課 = 她到學校去上課 (= 她去上課 when the place is clear).
Add the starting point with 從: 他從家裡去學校; 他從印尼到臺灣來學中文.

modules.title: 喂，你在做什麼呢？
modules.title_py: Wèi, nǐ zài zuò shén me ne?
modules.title_id: Hello, what are you doing?
modules.scene: In the evening Meimei is doing homework from the teacher's website, but the internet at her home is slow. She calls Dawen, who is online; then her phone battery runs low, and they agree to talk again in a little while.
can_do: Say what is happening RIGHT NOW (我在上網呢)
Open and end a phone call (喂…／一會兒打電話給你)
Use the conversational particles 啊/呀/啦 naturally
modules.exam_link: Ongoing activities are the core of 聽力 Part 1 ('他在做什麼？'). The difference between 'is doing' vs 'usually' vs 'later' is often a distractor in 聽力 Part 2.

lines.zh: 喂，大文，你在做什麼呢？
lines.py: Wèi, Dà wén, nǐ zài zuò shén me ne?
lines.id: Hello, Dawen, what are you doing?

lines.zh: 我在上網呢。你呢？
lines.py: Wǒ zài shàng wǎng ne. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: I'm on the internet. And you?

lines.zh: 我在寫功課，可是最近我家的網路很慢，我不能上老師的網站。
lines.py: Wǒ zài xiě gōng kè, kě shì zuì jìn wǒ jiā de wǎng lù hěn màn, wǒ bù néng shàng lǎo shī de wǎng zhàn.
lines.id: I'm doing my homework, but lately the internet at my place is slow, and I can't open the teacher's website.

lines.zh: 我正在看老師的網站呢。你要看哪個問題？
lines.py: Wǒ zhèng zài kàn lǎo shī de wǎng zhàn ne. Nǐ yào kàn nǎ ge wèn tí?
lines.id: I'm on the teacher's website right now. Which question do you want to see?

lines.zh: 第三個。
lines.py: Dì sān ge.
lines.id: The third one.

lines.zh: 等一下……第三個問題是：「你最近在做什麼？」
lines.py: Děng yí xià…… Dì sān ge wèn tí shì: "Nǐ zuì jìn zài zuò shén me?"
lines.id: Hold on… Question three: "What have you been doing lately?"

lines.zh: 啊，這個我會！謝謝你！
lines.py: A, zhè ge wǒ huì! Xiè xie nǐ!
lines.id: Ah, I can do this one! Thanks!

lines.zh: 啊，我的手機快沒電啦！我們一會兒再聊吧。
lines.py: A, wǒ de shǒu jī kuài méi diàn la! Wǒ men yí huìr zài liáo ba.
lines.id: Oh no, my phone's battery is almost dead! Let's talk again in a bit.

lines.zh: 好啊，一會兒再打給我。
lines.py: Hǎo a, yí huìr zài dǎ gěi wǒ.
lines.id: OK, call me again in a bit.

lines.zh: 喂，大文，你還在上網嗎？
lines.py: Wèi, Dà wén, nǐ hái zài shàng wǎng ma?
lines.id: Hello, Dawen, are you still online?

lines.zh: 沒有，我在跟志明聊天呢。你的功課呢？
lines.py: Méi yǒu, wǒ zài gēn Zhì míng liáo tiān ne. Nǐ de gōng kè ne?
lines.id: No, I'm chatting with Zhiming. How's your homework?

lines.zh: 都會啦！老師的問題很容易。
lines.py: Dōu huì la! Lǎo shī de wèn tí hěn róng yì.
lines.id: I can do all of it! The teacher's questions are easy.

lines.zh: 真好！志明說，他的功課還有很多呀！
lines.py: Zhēn hǎo! Zhì míng shuō, tā de gōng kè hái yǒu hěn duō ya!
lines.id: Lucky you! Zhiming says he still has lots of homework!

lines.zh: 那你們不要聊天啦，快去寫功課吧！
lines.py: Nà nǐ men bú yào liáo tiān la, kuài qù xiě gōng kè ba!
lines.id: Then you two stop chatting and go do your homework!

tasks.question: 你們在做什麼？
tasks.why: Two people chatting → 聊天. A: 看電視 = to watch TV. C: 吃飯 = to eat.

tasks.why: 在做什麼 asks what someone is doing RIGHT NOW. B = a habit/liking; C = tomorrow's plan.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer

tasks.why: Answer with a state: 很忙. B is incomplete; C uses an unnecessary 的.

lines.zh: 喂，妳現在忙嗎？
我正在上課，一會兒打電話給你。

tasks.question: 這位小姐現在在做什麼？
tasks.why: 我正在上課。 A: 打電話 will only happen 一會兒 (in a bit). C: 上網 is not mentioned.

lines.zh: 喂，你在做什麼呢？
我在上網。有事嗎？
我想跟你聊一下，你有空嗎？
等一會兒好嗎？我現在很忙。

tasks.question: 這位先生是什麼意思？
options: 他不想跟這位小姐說話
tasks.why: 等一會兒 = busy now, later. B: an overstatement (she is only postponing). C & D: the opposite / not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 他正在看電視。
tasks.why: 正在看電視 = watching TV. A: going online would be 上網. C: reading would be 看書.

tasks.why: Phone + chat bubbles → 用手機聊天。 B: 在教室上課 = having class in a classroom. C: 一起吃飯 = eating together.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 請等（　），我馬上來！
tasks.why: 等一下子 = wait a moment. A: 最近 = recently. C: 網路 = the internet.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 喂，你（1）做什麼（2）？我在（3），我們一會兒聊天吧！
tasks.why: (1) 在 + V = to be doing. (2) a question with a question word + 呢. (3) an activity → 上網. 嗎 is not used together with 什麼.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 晚上八點，爸爸在看電視，媽媽在打電話，我在上網，妹妹在跟朋友聊天。
tasks.question: 誰在上網？
tasks.why: 我在上網 — the writer (他 in the question). A: dad 看電視. B: mum 打電話. D: the younger sister 聊天.

grammar.point: 在／正在 + V — to be doing
grammar.explain: 在 or 正在 before a verb = an action in progress. 正在 stresses 'right now'. Compare with 在1 (A08): 我在家 = I am at home (在 + place).

examples.id: I'm on the internet.
I'm chatting with Annie.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 13, 17
note: 在 has two uses: 在 + place + V = doing something at a place (他在圖書館看書。); 在 + V = in the middle of doing (他在看書。).
正在 stresses 'right at that moment', often with a time clause: 你打電話的時候，我正在騎車。
Two activities at the same time: 一邊…一邊…: 她一邊吃飯，一邊看電視。

grammar.explain: 呢 at the end of a sentence softens questions with a question word (你在做什麼呢？) and stresses an ongoing situation (我在上網呢). Don't use it together with 嗎.

examples.id: So what are you up to?
I'm on the internet right now.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 5
note: Noun/person + 呢？ = 'what about …?' without repeating the question: 我有兩個哥哥，你呢？

modules.title: 歡迎歡迎！請進。
modules.title_py: Huān yíng huān yíng! Qǐng jìn.
modules.title_id: Welcome! Please come in.
modules.scene: Dawen visits Meimei's family home in Taichung: Meimei's mother welcomes him, he gives a gift, they have dinner together, and he politely takes his leave.
can_do: Welcome people and invite them with 請 (請進、請坐、請喝茶)
Politely forbid/decline: (請)不要…
Use polite expressions: 不好意思、麻煩您、不客氣、祝…
modules.exam_link: Social etiquette (thanking, apologising, declining offers) appears in 聽力 Part 4 with implied answers — e.g. 'I'm already full' means declining more food.

lines.zh: 歡迎歡迎！請進，請到客廳坐。
lines.py: Huān yíng huān yíng! Qǐng jìn, qǐng dào kè tīng zuò.
lines.id: Welcome, welcome! Come in, please have a seat in the living room.

lines.zh: 李太太，您好！不好意思，今天麻煩您。
lines.py: Lǐ tài tài, nín hǎo! Bù hǎo yì sī, jīn tiān má fán nín.
lines.id: Good afternoon, Mrs. Li! Sorry to trouble you today.

lines.zh: 不麻煩！請坐，請喝茶。
lines.py: Bù má fán! Qǐng zuò, qǐng hē chá.
lines.id: No trouble at all! Please sit down and have some tea.

lines.zh: 謝謝。這是印尼的咖啡，送您。
lines.py: Xiè xie. Zhè shì Yìn ní de kā fēi, sòng nín.
lines.id: Thank you. This is Indonesian coffee, for you.

lines.zh: 你太客氣啦！謝謝你。
lines.py: Nǐ tài kè qì la! Xiè xie nǐ.
lines.id: You're too kind! Thank you.

lines.zh: 大文，請到飯廳吃飯。請多吃，不要客氣！
lines.py: Dà wén, qǐng dào fàn tīng chī fàn. Qǐng duō chī, bú yào kè qì!
lines.id: Dawen, please come and eat in the dining room. Eat plenty, don't be shy!

lines.zh: 謝謝，菜很好吃！
lines.py: Xiè xie, cài hěn hǎo chī!
lines.id: Thank you, the food is delicious!

lines.zh: 我媽媽很會做菜。
lines.py: Wǒ mā ma hěn huì zuò cài.
lines.id: My mom is a great cook.

lines.zh: 不好意思，九點我要坐火車，明天早上有課。
lines.py: Bù hǎo yì sī, jiǔ diǎn wǒ yào zuò huǒ chē, míng tiān zǎo shàng yǒu kè.
lines.id: Excuse me, I have to catch a train at nine; I have class tomorrow morning.

lines.zh: 請不要走路去火車站，美美送你去。
lines.py: Qǐng bú yào zǒu lù qù huǒ chē zhàn, Měi měi sòng nǐ qù.
lines.id: Please don't walk to the station; Meimei will take you.

lines.zh: 謝謝您！祝您週末快樂！
lines.py: Xiè xie nín! Zhù nín zhōu mò kuài lè!
lines.id: Thank you! Have a nice weekend!

lines.zh: 不客氣，歡迎你再來！
lines.py: Bú kè qì, huān yíng nǐ zài lái!
lines.id: You're welcome, come again!

tasks.why: 請喝茶 = please have some tea. 咖啡 = coffee; 酒 = alcoholic drink.

謝謝。

謝謝，我吃很多，很飽啦。

tasks.why: 很飽啦 = already full → politely declining more food. B is the reverse; C is not implied (she says she has eaten a lot); D misunderstands 不要客氣.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: （1）你來我家！（2）進，請坐。（3）客氣，多吃一點！
tasks.why: (1) welcoming → 歡迎. (2) 請進. (3) 不要客氣 = don't be shy. 麻煩 is said by the guest, not the host.

tasks.instr: Read the signs in this house, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 客廳：請不要吃東西。飯廳：請不要看手機。
tasks.question: 飯廳裡不可以做什麼？
tasks.why: 飯廳：請不要看手機. 吃東西 is forbidden in the living room, not the dining room — a mixed-up distractor.

grammar.explain: 請 before a verb makes an invitation/request polite: 請進 (please come in), 請坐, 請多吃一點. A person can be inserted: 請你幫我 (could you please …). 請問 (excuse me) is a fixed expression.

examples.id: Please come in, please sit down!
Please eat some more.

grammar.explain: 不要 + verb = a prohibition, 'don't'. With 請 in front it becomes polite. Here 不要 is NOT 'don't want' — the meaning depends on the verb that follows.

examples.id: Don't be shy!
Please don't walk.

check.q: A sign in the library: 'Please do not eat'

core.meaning: to give (a present); to see someone off
core.note: Two 義項 are used in this scene: 這個送您 (to give) and 美美送你去火車站 (to take someone somewhere).

modules.title: 很高興認識你！
modules.title_py: Hěn gāo xìng rèn shí nǐ!
modules.title_id: Nice to meet you!
modules.scene: A welcome party for international students. Annie has just arrived and doesn't know anyone yet; Meimei introduces her to Dawen, who is also from Indonesia, and then they meet the teacher's family.
can_do: Meet people: 很高興認識你！／我也很高興認識你。
Refer to groups of people with 們 (同學們、朋友們)
Add information with 也 in the right position
modules.exam_link: Social introductions appear in 聽力 Part 2 (the right response). The position of 也 (after the subject) is often tested in 閱讀 Part 4.

lines.zh: 你好，你是新同學嗎？歡迎你！
lines.py: Nǐ hǎo, nǐ shì xīn tóng xué ma? Huān yíng nǐ!
lines.id: Hi, are you a new student? Welcome!

lines.zh: 對，我叫安妮。很高興認識你！
lines.py: Duì, wǒ jiào Ān nī. Hěn gāo xìng rèn shì nǐ!
lines.id: Yes, my name is Annie. Nice to meet you!

lines.zh: 我叫美美，我也很高興認識你。今天有各國的學生，也有老師們。
lines.py: Wǒ jiào Měi měi, wǒ yě hěn gāo xìng rèn shì nǐ. Jīn tiān yǒu gè guó de xué shēng, yě yǒu lǎo shī men.
lines.id: I'm Meimei, nice to meet you too. Today there are students from many countries, and teachers too.

lines.zh: 人很多，可是我不認識別人。
lines.py: Rén hěn duō, kě shì wǒ bú rèn shì bié rén.
lines.id: There are lots of people, but I don't know anyone else.

lines.zh: 沒關係！你是哪國人？
lines.py: Méi guān xì! Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
lines.id: No problem! Where are you from?

lines.zh: 我是印尼人。
lines.py: Wǒ shì Yìn ní rén.
lines.id: I'm Indonesian.

lines.zh: 那邊的大文也是印尼人！大文，這是安妮。
lines.py: Nà biān de Dà wén yě shì Yìn ní rén! Dà wén, zhè shì Ān nī.
lines.id: Dawen over there is Indonesian too! Dawen, this is Annie.

lines.zh: 你好！你也是印尼人嗎？我是雅加達人。
lines.py: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ yě shì Yìn ní rén ma? Wǒ shì Yǎ jiā dá rén.
lines.id: Hi! You're Indonesian too? I'm from Jakarta.

lines.zh: 我也是雅加達人！很高興見到你。
lines.py: Wǒ yě shì Yǎ jiā dá rén! Hěn gāo xìng jiàn dào nǐ.
lines.id: I'm from Jakarta too! Nice to meet you.

lines.zh: 我們的同學們都很好，你可以交很多朋友。
lines.py: Wǒ men de tóng xué men dōu hěn hǎo, nǐ kě yǐ jiāo hěn duō péng yǒu.
lines.id: Our classmates are all really nice; you can make lots of friends.

lines.zh: 那邊的大人和小朋友們是誰？
lines.py: Nà biān de dà rén hàn xiǎo péng yǒu men shì shéi?
lines.id: Who are the adults and children over there?

lines.zh: 他們是陳老師的家人。那個老人是老師的爸爸。
lines.py: Tā men shì Chén lǎo shī de jiā rén. Nà ge lǎo rén shì lǎo shī de bà ba.
lines.id: They're Teacher Chen's family. That old man is the teacher's father.

lines.zh: 老師的爸爸很喜歡跟年輕人聊天。我們也去吧！
lines.py: Lǎo shī de bà ba hěn xǐ huān gēn nián qīng rén liáo tiān. Wǒ men yě qù ba!
lines.id: The teacher's father loves chatting with young people. Let's go over too!

lines.zh: 安妮，歡迎你！這是我爸爸，這是我的兒子們。
lines.py: Ān nī, huān yíng nǐ! Zhè shì wǒ bà ba, zhè shì wǒ de ér zi men.
lines.id: Annie, welcome! This is my father, and these are my sons.

lines.zh: 老先生好！小朋友們好！
lines.py: Lǎo xiān shēng hǎo! Xiǎo péng yǒu men hǎo!
lines.id: Good afternoon, sir! Hi, kids!

lines.zh: 其他的新同學呢？
lines.py: Qí tā de xīn tóng xué ne?
lines.id: Where are the other new students?

lines.zh: 他們在那邊跟大家聊天呢。安妮今天也認識很多新朋友！
lines.py: Tā men zài nà biān gēn dà jiā liáo tiān ne. Ān nī jīn tiān yě rèn shì hěn duō xīn péng yǒu!
lines.id: They're over there chatting with everyone. Annie has met lots of new friends today too!

lines.zh: 對，我今天很高興！我們下個星期見面吧！
lines.py: Duì, wǒ jīn tiān hěn gāo xìng! Wǒ men xià ge xīng qī jiàn miàn ba!
lines.id: Yes, I'm so happy today! Let's meet up next week!

grammar.explain: 們 marks the plural for PEOPLE: 同學們, 朋友們, 老師們 (and the pronouns 我們/你們/他們). It is not used for things, and not when there is already a number: 三個同學 (not 三個同學們).

examples.id: Everyone, this is a new classmate.

examples.zh: 大人們和小朋友們都很高興。
examples.id: The adults and children are all happy.

grammar.explain: 也 always goes AFTER the subject and BEFORE the verb (never at the start or end of the sentence like English 'too'). Negative: 也不 (not … either).

examples.id: Nice to meet you too.
She can speak English too.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 9
note: When two people do the same thing, a pair of sentences with 也 can be merged with 都: 小芳想吃包子，小美也想吃包子 → 她們都想吃包子.
也 works in negative sentences too, still before 不: 他不高，我也不高 (✗ 也我不高).

grammar.point: (在) PW 的 N — the thing at …
grammar.explain: A place phrase can describe a noun with 的: 客廳裡的電視 = the TV in the living room. The whole phrase can then be a subject/object: 客廳裡的電視是房東的.

examples.id: The books on the table are mine.
The building near campus

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 12
note: Three place patterns that are easy to mix up: (1) 冰箱上面有一個杯子 = on the fridge THERE IS a cup (new item); (2) 冰箱上面的那個杯子是爸爸的 = the cup ON the fridge is Dad's (place + 的 + noun as subject); (3) 小明的左邊是小芳 = to Xiaoming's left IS Xiaofang (who occupies that spot).
在 before the place is optional: (在)冰箱裡有牛奶; (在)冰箱上面的那個杯子.

grammar.explain: When the thing is clear, just owner + 的: 這個是我的 (this is mine), 那個是室友的. To ask: 這是誰的？

examples.zh: 這個是我的，那個是室友的。
examples.id: This one's mine, that one's my roommate's.
The TV is the landlord's.

check.q: The answer to 這本書是誰的？

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 6, 23
note: From the full sentence to the short form: 這是我的咖啡 → 這杯咖啡是我的. Asking the owner: 這是誰的眼鏡? → 那是爺爺的.
The same pattern with adjectives: 那兩輛車，哪輛是你的? → 大的是我的，小的是我妹妹的 (the big one is mine, the small one is my sister's). See also A19.

lines.zh: 大文，你家在幾樓？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ jiā zài jǐ lóu?
lines.id: Dawen, which floor do you live on?

lines.zh: 在七樓。可是今天電梯不能坐，我們走樓梯吧。
lines.py: Zài qī lóu. Kě shì jīn tiān diàn tī bù néng zuò, wǒ men zǒu lóu tī ba.
lines.id: The seventh. But the lift is out today, so let's take the stairs.

lines.zh: 七樓！好高啊！你家樓上還有人嗎？
lines.py: Qī lóu! Hǎo gāo a! Nǐ jiā lóu shàng hái yǒu rén ma?

lines.zh: 有，樓上住著一個老先生。他每天都走樓梯！
lines.py: Yǒu, lóu shàng zhù zhe yí ge lǎo xiān shēng. Tā měi tiān dōu zǒu lóu tī!

lines.zh: 你看，窗戶開著，冷氣也開著！
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, chuāng hù kāi zhe, lěng qì yě kāi zhe!

lines.zh: 燈也開著！家裡沒有人啊！
lines.py: Dēng yě kāi zhe! Jiā lǐ méi yǒu rén a!
lines.id: The lights are on too! And nobody's home!

lines.zh: 是你的室友嗎？
lines.py: Shì nǐ de shì yǒu ma?
lines.id: Your roommate?

lines.zh: 對，志明早上很忙。
lines.py: Duì, Zhì míng zǎo shàng hěn máng.
lines.id: Yes, Zhiming is always in a rush in the morning.

lines.zh: 這是書房嗎？
lines.py: Zhè shì shū fáng ma?

lines.zh: 對，我晚上常常在書房看書。洗手間在書房對面。
lines.py: Duì, wǒ wǎn shàng cháng cháng zài shū fáng kàn shū. Xǐ shǒu jiān zài shū fáng duì miàn.
lines.id: Yes, I often read in the study in the evening. The bathroom is across from the study.

lines.zh: 我想喝水。冰箱在哪裡？
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng hē shuǐ. Bīng xiāng zài nǎ lǐ?

lines.zh: 在飯廳，在桌子和窗戶中間。
lines.py: Zài fàn tīng, zài zhuō zi hàn chuāng hù zhōng jiān.

lines.zh: 我們去樓下的咖啡店坐一下吧。
lines.py: Wǒ men qù lóu xià de kā fēi diàn zuò yí xià ba.

grammar.explain: 著 after a verb = the result of the action continues: 開著 (open/on), 關著 (closed). Different from 在 + V (in the middle of doing).

examples.id: The window is open.
The air conditioning is on too.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 32
note: V著 describes a visible STATE: 門開著、燈關著、他穿著襯衫、她戴著眼鏡.
Compare: 他正在穿襯衫 = he is PUTTING ON a shirt (the action) vs 他穿著襯衫 = he is WEARING a shirt (the state).

grammar.point: 在3 — doing something AT a place
grammar.explain: The place of the activity goes BEFORE the verb, with 在: 我在書房看書 (not 我看書在書房). This order is required in Mandarin.

examples.id: I often read in the study.
I go online in the study every day.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 13
note: Asking what someone does at a place: 小明在餐廳做什麼? → 他在餐廳上班.
POSITION verbs (住、坐、站、躺、放) use the reverse order, V + 在 + place: 我住在二樓、小文坐在教室後面、杯子放在桌子上 (see B30).

grammar.explain: 幫 + person + verb = to help someone do something / to do it for them. 我來幫你 = let me help you. The nouns: 幫忙 (help, 謝謝你幫忙) and 幫助 (more formal).

examples.id: I'll help with the dishes.
Let's ask the landlord for help.

grammar.explain: 了 at the END of a sentence marks a new/changed situation: 冷氣壞了 (it was fine, now it's broken), 房間乾淨了 (it's clean now), 我太忙了. This is not a 'past tense' — past time is covered in B33.

examples.id: The room's clean now!
The air conditioning has broken.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 21
note: 了 at the end = something has CHANGED: 他胖了 (he wasn't fat before), 小孩子不哭了 (the child was crying, now has stopped), 她會說中文了 (she couldn't before).
With a negative it means "no longer": 他以前很喜歡吃魚，現在不喜歡吃了.
The amount of change comes after adjective + 了: 他胖了五公斤、小男孩大了一歲、他胖了好幾公斤.

lines.zh: 平常洗二十分鐘。

lines.zh: 二十分鐘？好久啊！我總是洗五分鐘。
lines.py: Èr shí fēn zhōng? Hǎo jiǔ a! Wǒ zǒng shì xǐ wǔ fēn zhōng.

lines.py: Zhè shì wǒ de xí guàn. Zài Yìn ní, wǒ yì tiān xǐ zǎo xǐ liǎng cì.

lines.zh: 好。下課以後你一直上網，上三個小時，你可以晚一點洗。
lines.py: Hǎo. Xià kè yǐ hòu nǐ yì zhí shàng wǎng, shàng sān ge xiǎo shí, nǐ kě yǐ wǎn yì diǎn xǐ.

lines.zh: 可是週一早上我也有課。
lines.py: Kě shì zhōu yī zǎo shàng wǒ yě yǒu kè.

lines.zh: 那週一你早一點起床！
lines.py: Nà zhōu yī nǐ zǎo yì diǎn qǐ chuáng!

lines.zh: 好。週日呢？

lines.zh: 這個禮拜天，你可以洗一個小時！

tasks.why: 看書看一個小時. 三十分鐘 is how long the morning run lasts.

grammar.point: 時量補語 — duration of an activity
grammar.explain: The duration goes AFTER the verb. If there is an object, the verb is repeated: 洗澡洗十分鐘, 跑步跑半個小時. To ask: V 多久？ Compare: 幾點 (what time) goes BEFORE the verb.

examples.id: I shower for ten minutes.

examples.zh: 我每天跑步跑半個小時。
examples.id: I run for half an hour every day.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 15, 17
note: Asking how long: 幾分鐘? 幾個鐘頭? = 幾(個)小時? 幾天? 30 minutes = 半個鐘頭 = 半(個)小時; 1.5 hours = 一個半鐘頭; over two hours = 兩個多鐘頭.
Besides repeating the verb, the duration can sit between verb and object with 的: 坐四十分鐘的車、打一個鐘頭的網球、睡八個鐘頭的覺.
A finished event takes 了: 小明昨天坐了四十分鐘的車. A habit (每天) takes NO 了: 小明每天坐四十分鐘的車.
我學了兩年中文 = studied for two years (and stopped); 我學了兩年中文了 = have been studying for two years (and still am).

grammar.explain: …以後 = after … . It goes AFTER the activity/time (unlike English 'after' at the front): 下課以後 = after class, 三天以後 = three days later.

examples.zh: 下課以後，我去公園慢跑。
examples.id: After class I go jogging in the park.
After eating, I'm on the internet the whole time.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 21
note: 以後 after a length of time = '… later': 半年以後; after an event = 'after …': 畢業以後、來臺灣以後.
以後 on its own at the start = 'in the future': 以後他想搬到日本去.

modules.title_py: Wǒ cóng jiǔ diǎn gōng zuò dào wǔ diǎn.

modules.exam_link: Work & the workplace are a FREQUENT topic in 聽力 Parts 1–4 and 閱讀 Part 5 (job adverts). Working hours are often turned into calculation questions.

lines.zh: 大文，歡迎你來我們公司！
lines.py: Dà wén, huān yíng nǐ lái wǒ men gōng sī!
lines.id: Dawen, welcome to our company!

lines.zh: 謝謝您！我很高興有這個機會。
lines.py: Xiè xie nín! Wǒ hěn gāo xìng yǒu zhè ge jī huì.
lines.id: Thank you! I'm very happy to have this opportunity.

lines.zh: 我們從早上九點工作到下午五點。你的辦公室在三樓。
lines.py: Wǒ men cóng zǎo shàng jiǔ diǎn gōng zuò dào xià wǔ wǔ diǎn. Nǐ de bàn gōng shì zài sān lóu.
lines.id: We work from nine in the morning to five in the afternoon. Your office is on the third floor.

lines.zh: 好。我沒有工作經驗，有問題可以問您嗎？
lines.py: Hǎo. Wǒ méi yǒu gōng zuò jīng yàn, yǒu wèn tí kě yǐ wèn nín ma?
lines.id: OK. I don't have any work experience; may I ask you if I have questions?

lines.zh: 可以。你的中文能力很好，下個星期開始，你可以一個人工作。
lines.py: Kě yǐ. Nǐ de Zhōng wén néng lì hěn hǎo, xià ge xīng qī kāi shǐ, nǐ kě yǐ yí ge rén gōng zuò.
lines.id: Yes. Your Chinese is very good; starting next week you can work on your own.

lines.zh: 大文，你下班了嗎？第一天上班怎麼樣？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ xià bān le ma? Dì yī tiān shàng bān zěn me yàng?
lines.id: Dawen, are you off work? How was your first day?

lines.zh: 很好！可是從九點工作到五點，好累！
lines.py: Hěn hǎo! Kě shì cóng jiǔ diǎn gōng zuò dào wǔ diǎn, hǎo lèi!
lines.id: Good! But working from nine to five is so tiring!

lines.zh: 你以後想在公司上班嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ yǐ hòu xiǎng zài gōng sī shàng bān ma?
lines.id: Do you want to work at a company in the future?

lines.zh: 不想，我想當老師，教中文。我的計畫是：明年開始教印尼人中文。
lines.py: Bù xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng dāng lǎo shī, jiāo Zhōng wén. Wǒ de jì huà shì: míng nián kāi shǐ jiào Yìn ní rén Zhōng wén.
lines.id: No, I want to be a teacher and teach Chinese. My plan is to start teaching Chinese to Indonesians next year.

lines.zh: 在公司上班，你的中文也會進步。這是好辦法！
lines.py: Zài gōng sī shàng bān, nǐ de Zhōng wén yě huì jìn bù. Zhè shì hǎo bàn fǎ!
lines.id: Working at a company will improve your Chinese too. It's a good way!

lines.zh: 對！可是當老師沒有很有錢啊。
lines.py: Duì! Kě shì dāng lǎo shī méi yǒu hěn yǒu qián a.
lines.id: True! But teachers don't get very rich.

lines.zh: 沒關係，你喜歡就好！
lines.py: Méi guān xì, nǐ xǐ huān jiù hǎo!
lines.id: Never mind, as long as you like it!

grammar.point: 以前 — in the past / before
grammar.pattern: S + 以前 + VP ／ activity + 以前
grammar.explain: 以前 on its own = in the past (我爺爺以前是醫生). After an activity/time = before (上課以前 = before class). The opposite: 以後 (B10). 後來 = later (for past stories).

examples.zh: 我奶奶以前在公司上班。
examples.id: My grandmother used to work in an office.
Before class, I drink coffee.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 21
note: 以前 after a length of time = '… ago': 三個月以前 = three months ago; after an event = 'before …': 畢業以前.
Timeline: 從前 (long ago) → 以前 (before) → 剛 (just now) → 現在 → 以後 (later). 本來…後來… = at first…later: 她本來不懂中文，後來學了兩年中文，現在她在臺灣工作.

grammar.pattern: S + V + 過 + O ／ 沒 + V + 過
grammar.explain: 過 after a verb = to have experienced something. Negative: 沒V過 (have never), not 不V過. To ask: V過嗎？

examples.id: I've been to my grandparents' house.

examples.zh: 我沒看過臺灣的棒球比賽。
examples.id: I've never watched Taiwanese baseball.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 20
note: V過 = EXPERIENCE: 我吃過包子，很好吃. 沒V過 = never: 我沒吃過包子.
Careful: (已經)V過了 answers 'have you … yet?' about routine things, NOT experience: 你吃飯了沒有? → 我已經吃過了 (I've already eaten). This is V過2 in C01.
Positive and negative can be combined: 我看過法國電影，吃過西班牙菜，可是沒去過歐洲.

supplement.meaning: to grow; to look (長得… = looks …)

grammar.point: 幾 vs 多少 — how many
grammar.pattern: 幾 + 量 + N ／ 多少 (+量) + N
grammar.explain: 幾 is used when the expected answer is small (under 10) and MUST be followed by a measure word. 多少 is for any/large amounts, the measure word is optional; it is also used for prices and phone numbers (號碼是多少).

examples.id: How many men are in your class?
How many students does our university have?

check.q: Phone number: 你的電話號碼是＿＿？

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 7
note: Rule of thumb: amount ≤ 10 → 幾 + measure + N (你家有幾個人?); amount > 10 → 多少 (+measure) + N (你有多少朋友?).
Prices always use 多少: 一杯咖啡多少錢? = 咖啡，一杯多少錢? Money: 塊 (spoken) = 元 (written): 五十塊錢 = 五十塊 = 五十元.

grammar.point: 數詞 + 多 (+量) — more than
grammar.explain: 多 after a round number (十, 二十, 一百, 一千…) = 'more than, -odd'. It goes BEFORE the measure word: 二十多歲 (twenty-something years old), 十多個 (a dozen or so), 三百多個.

examples.id: A dozen or so are women.

examples.zh: 全學校有一千多個學生。
examples.id: The whole university has over a thousand students.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 8
note: 多 goes BEFORE the measure word after round tens/hundreds: 十多杯 (11–19 cups), 三十多萬. 多 goes AFTER the measure word when the extra is less than one unit: 十杯多 (a bit over 10 cups, not yet 11), 兩瓶多、三塊多、一斤多.
Large numbers: 1,269 → 一千兩百多; 21,500 → 兩萬多; 360,000 → 三十多萬.

grammar.pattern: 十/二十/… + 幾 + 量 + N
grammar.explain: 幾 after a tens number = an uncertain unit digit: 十幾 (a dozen or so), 二十幾 (twenty-something), 七點多/幾分. Here 幾 is NOT a question word.

examples.zh: 我們班有三十幾個學生。
examples.id: My class had thirty-something students.
There are a dozen or so books in the bag.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 8, 15
note: Here 幾 and 多 mean the same: 十幾 = 十多 (teens); 三十幾萬 = 三十多萬.
Also for clock time and duration: 八點多 (just after eight), 二十幾分鐘, 十幾個鐘頭.

grammar.pattern: 兩三 + 量 ／ 差不多 + number
grammar.explain: Two consecutive numbers = an estimate: 兩三個 (two or three), 七八天. 差不多 + number = about. No 'or' is needed between them.

modules.title: 他中文說得很好！

modules.exam_link: The V得 pattern (說得很好) appears in 聽力 Parts 3–4 and 閱讀 Part 4 ('打掃得很乾淨'). Responses to compliments (哪裡哪裡) are often tested in 聽力 Part 2.

grammar.explain: 用 + tool + verb = to do something WITH that tool. The tool goes BEFORE the main verb: 用中文說 (to say it in Mandarin), 用字典學.

examples.id: I learn new characters with a dictionary.

examples.zh: 你可以用中文講這個故事嗎？
examples.id: Can you tell this story in Mandarin?

grammar.explain: 得 after a verb gives an evaluation of HOW it is done/the result: 說得很好 (speaks well). Negative: 說得不好 (not 不說得好). The object goes in front: 中文說得很好, or the verb is repeated: 說中文說得很好.

examples.id: Your Mandarin is really good!
You didn't write this character very clearly.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 22, 25
note: Asking: 他說得好不好? = 他說得怎麼樣? Answers: 說得很好 / 說得不好 / 說得真不錯.
If there is an object, mention it first: 李英愛的中文說得很好 = 李英愛，中文說得很好 (✗ 說中文得很好).
Comparing how things are done: A 說得比 B 好 = A 比 B 說得好; A 跟 B 說得一樣好; A 說得沒有 B 好.

modules.title: 中文要怎麼學？
modules.title_py: Zhōng wén yào zěn me xué?
modules.title_id: How should I study Mandarin?
modules.scene: There's a Chinese test next week, and Dawen keeps forgetting characters. He asks his senior, Anan, for advice; the day before the test Meimei checks that he's ready.
can_do: Ask how to do something: 怎麼 + V？
Give advice/obligations with 要 (你要多練習)
Talk about exam preparation and ways of remembering
modules.exam_link: Advice & study strategies appear in 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 5 ('what is the advice?' questions). 怎麼 + V often appears in 聽力 Part 2.

lines.zh: 安安，下個星期要考中文，可是中文字很難，我常常忘。我要怎麼學？
lines.py: Ān ān, xià ge xīng qī yào kǎo Zhōng wén, kě shì Zhōng wén zì hěn nán, wǒ cháng cháng wàng. Wǒ yào zěn me xué?
lines.id: Anan, there's a Chinese test next week, but Chinese characters are hard and I keep forgetting them. How should I study?

lines.zh: 你要每天念書，一天寫十個字。
lines.py: Nǐ yào měi tiān niàn shū, yì tiān xiě shí ge zì.
lines.id: You need to study every day and write ten characters a day.

lines.zh: 寫十個字，我就會記得嗎？
lines.py: Xiě shí ge zì, wǒ jiù huì jì de ma?
lines.id: If I write ten characters, will I remember them?

lines.zh: 你也要常常看，常常用。學習語言，這個方法最簡單。
lines.py: Nǐ yě yào cháng cháng kàn, cháng cháng yòng. Xué xí yǔ yán, zhè ge fāng fǎ zuì jiǎn dān.
lines.id: You also need to look at them and use them often. For learning a language, this is the simplest method.

lines.zh: 好，我要努力！
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ yào nǔ lì!
lines.id: OK, I'll work hard!

lines.zh: 大文，明天考試，你準備了嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, míng tiān kǎo shì, nǐ zhǔn bèi le ma?
lines.id: Dawen, the test is tomorrow. Are you ready?

lines.zh: 準備了！這個星期我每天都很用功。
lines.py: Zhǔn bèi le! Zhè ge xīng qī wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn yòng gōng.
lines.id: Yes! I studied hard every day this week.

lines.zh: 考試的字你都會寫嗎？
lines.py: Kǎo shì de zì nǐ dōu huì xiě ma?
lines.id: Can you write all the characters for the test?

lines.zh: 都會寫！安安的方法很好。
lines.py: Dōu huì xiě! Ān ān de fāng fǎ hěn hǎo.
lines.id: All of them! Anan's method is good.

lines.zh: 別忘了，考試需要帶筆。
lines.py: Bié wàng le, kǎo shì xū yào dài bǐ.
lines.id: Don't forget, you need to bring a pen to the test.

lines.zh: 我記得！
lines.py: Wǒ jì de!
lines.id: I remember!

grammar.explain: 到 after a verb = the goal is achieved: 找 (to look for) → 找到 (to find), 買 → 買到 (managed to buy), 聽 → 聽到. Negative: 沒找到.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 31
note: "Can/can't" form: V得到 / V不到: 車站離我家不遠，十分鐘就走得到 (you can walk there in ten minutes).
才 + V到 = only managed after much effort: 買票的人很多，我排了兩個小時的隊才買到.

grammar.explain: 見 after 看/聽 = actually caught by the eyes/ears: 看 (to look, an action) vs 看見 (to see). 我沒聽見 = I didn't hear (it didn't register).

examples.id: Have you seen my notebook?
I didn't hear.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 31
note: "Can/can't" form: 看得見 / 看不見, 聽得見 / 聽不見: 前面的人都比我高，我看不見.
Other result words work the same way: 完、到、懂、清楚、飽 — 看懂、聽清楚、吃飽.

grammar.explain: 會 also means 'will/is likely to' (a prediction): 明天會下雪. Compare 會1 (B01) = can because you've learned it. Clue: there is a future time word, or the subject isn't a person (the weather) → 會2.

grammar.explain: 如果 or 要是 opens the condition; 就 in the second clause (after the subject) introduces the result. 就 can be dropped in conversation.

grammar.point: A 比 B + Vs — A is more … than B
grammar.explain: The comparison pattern: A 比 B + adjective. DON'T use 很 before the adjective (臺北比雅加達很冷 ✗); to intensify use 更 (更熱), or 比較 for 'somewhat more'.

examples.id: Taipei is colder than Jakarta.
Jakarta is much hotter than Taipei.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 23–25
note: The difference goes AFTER the adjective: 臺北比雅加達冷一點 / 冷多了 / 冷得多 / 冷五度. ✗ 比雅加達很冷 ✗ 比雅加達一點冷.
Negative: A 沒有 B + Vs: 臺北沒有雅加達那麼熱。 Also: A 不像 B 那麼 + Vs.
比較 = rather/more (without naming B), 更 = even more, 最 = the most: 這三個城市，雅加達最熱。
Comparing how something is done: (V O) V得 + 比 B + Vs: 他中文說得比我好。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 7
note: A 比不上 B / A 不如 B = A falls short of B (B is better): 火車的速度比不上高鐵的速度。

grammar.point: A 跟 B 一樣 (+Vs) — A is as … as B
grammar.explain: 跟…一樣 = the same as; add an adjective for the aspect that is the same: 一樣貴 (just as expensive). Negative: 跟…不一樣 (different).

examples.id: This one is as expensive as that one.
Taipei is different from Taichung.

check.q: 'I'm as tall as my older brother' =

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 24
note: The negation goes right before 一樣: A 跟 B 不一樣 (+ Vs). ✗ A 不跟 B 一樣.
Do not add 很 after 一樣: ✓ 他跟我一樣高。 ✗ 他跟我一樣很高。

grammar.explain: 太…了 = too … (usually a complaint). It can also be a positive exclamation: 太好了！ (great!). 了 usually goes at the end.

examples.id: This jacket's too big!
The weather's too hot.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 23
note: After complaining with 太…了, ask for a better fit with Vs + 一點的: 這件太大了，我要小一點的。
Asking whether there is a … one: 有沒有大一點的？ = 有大一點的嗎？

grammar.explain: 有(一)點 BEFORE an adjective = a bit …, usually for something undesirable: 有點貴, 有點小. Don't confuse it with Vs一點 (B21), used to ask for 'a bit more …'.

examples.id: That one's a bit small, and a bit expensive too.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 19, 23
note: Watch the position: 有(一)點 + Vs (before the adjective) = a bit, usually something unwelcome: 這件有一點貴。 Vs + 一點 (after the adjective) = a little more, for comparing/asking: 我要便宜一點的。
不太 + Vs = not very: 不太遠 (= 不怎麼遠).

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 23
note: When the thing is clear from context, the NOUN can be dropped; just say the quality + 的: 這件太大了，我要小一點的 (= 小一點的外套). 大的 = the big one, 新的 = the new one, 黑的 = the black one.
Only the noun is dropped — 的 must NOT go too: ✓ 我要大的。 ✗ 我要大。
Owner + 的 can stand alone too: 這個手錶是我的 (= mine). 那頂帽子是美美的 (= Meimei's).
With a measure word to point at something: 我要那件黑的。 這件是新的，那件是舊的。
Compare: 這件外套很大 (很 + Vs describes it as "big") with 我要大的 (Vs + 的 = "the big one", replacing the noun).
The same pattern returns in C40: 這雙鞋大了一點，我要小一點的。

grammar.point: Vs + 一點 — a bit more …
grammar.explain: 一點 AFTER an adjective = a bit more …, used for asking/comparing: 大一點的 (a bigger one), 便宜一點 (a bit cheaper). Compare: 有點大 (B20) = a bit too big (complaining).

examples.id: I want a slightly bigger one.
Do you have a cheaper one?

check.q: Asking a shop assistant: 'a lighter one'

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 23, 35
note: Asking for one that is "more …": 這雙鞋有沒有大一點的? = 有大一點的嗎? 這張桌子太矮了，我要高一點的.
Telling someone to change how they do something: Vs一點 + V or V + Vs一點: 快一點進教室; 你走得太慢了，走快一點; 開慢一點.
Compare: 比較 + Vs = relatively more, without naming what it is compared to: 大的貴，小的比較便宜.

grammar.point: A 還是 B — A or B? (choice question)
grammar.explain: 還是 is used in choice QUESTIONS and takes no 嗎. The answer picks one. (For 'or' in statements, 或是 is used, in B28.)

examples.zh: 你要藍色的還是黑色的？
examples.id: Do you want the blue one or the black one?

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 18
note: 還是 is for QUESTIONS: 你要喝咖啡還是可樂? 或是 is for STATEMENTS: 咖啡或是可樂都可以.
Also for times and activities: 你想這個星期還是下個星期去海邊? → 這星期或是下星期都可以.

grammar.point: 多／少 + V — do more / do less
grammar.pattern: S + 多/少 + V + (一點) + O
grammar.explain: 多 or 少 BEFORE a verb = to do more/less: 多喝水 (drink more water), 少買一點 (buy just a little). Often used for advice.

examples.id: Let's buy more water.
You should drink more water and less coffee.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 34
note: 多/少 go before the verb; the amount comes AFTER the verb: 多穿一件衣服、多穿一點、少開車 (✗ 穿多一件).
Often used for advice: 天氣越來越冷了，多穿一件衣服吧; 為了我們的環境，大家應該少開車.

grammar.explain: 都 sums up everything mentioned BEFORE it and goes after the subject, before the verb/adjective. 不都 = not all; 都不 = none.

examples.id: Milk and fruit are both cheap.
Not everything is cheap.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 9
note: 都 sums up what was mentioned BEFORE it: 小芳想吃包子，小美也想吃包子 → 她們兩個人都想吃包子.
Watch where 不 goes: 他們都不胖 = none of them is fat; 這些果汁不都是蘋果汁 = not all of these are apple juice (some aren't).

grammar.point: 又 A 又 B — both … and …
grammar.pattern: S + 又 + Vs1 + 又 + Vs2
grammar.explain: 又…又… combines two qualities (usually both positive or both negative) without 很: 又香又甜, 又辣又鹹.

examples.id: This cake is fragrant and sweet!
Indonesian food is spicy and salty.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 20
note: 又…又 takes no 很: ✓ 又乾淨又漂亮 ✗ 又很乾淨又很漂亮. It also works with phrases: 又有文化，又有歷史.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 9
note: A more formal version: 既…又…: 臺灣的鳳梨酥既便宜又好吃.

grammar.point: V + Vs — the result of an action
grammar.explain: An adjective right after a verb expresses the RESULT of the action: 洗乾淨 (to wash clean), 吃飽 (to eat until full), 寫錯 (to write wrongly). Negative: 沒洗乾淨.

examples.id: The vegetables need to be washed clean first.
I'm full!

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 31
note: "Can/can't" form: 吃得完 / 吃不完, 洗得乾淨 / 洗不乾淨: 這件衣服我已經洗了三次，還是洗不乾淨.
我吃飽了 = I'm full; 我沒吃飽 = I'm not full yet (still hungry); 十個餃子，你吃得飽嗎? = will ten dumplings be enough to fill you up?

grammar.point: V1 了 (O) 就 V2 — once …, right away …
grammar.pattern: S + V1 + 了 + (O) + 就 + V2
grammar.explain: 了 marks that the first action is finished, 就 that the second follows at once. It works for habits or plans: 我下了課就回家.

examples.id: Once the vegetables are washed, stir-fry them straight away.
Once the chicken's fried, I'll eat right away.

check.q: 'After eating I go straight to bed' =

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 26
note: V1了就V2 = right away: 秋華畢了業就開始工作. With 才 it means late: 心怡畢了業才開始找工作 (only started looking for work much later).

grammar.point: V來／V去 — direction of an action
grammar.explain: 來/去 after a verb shows the direction relative to the speaker: 帶來 (bring here), 帶去 (take there), 買來 (buy and bring here).

note: 來 = toward the speaker, 去 = away: 他們今天搬來這裡; 這本字典，你拿去用吧.
The direction follows the speaker: 請上來 (come up here — speaker is upstairs); 他下去了 (he has gone down — speaker stays upstairs).

grammar.explain: 好嗎 at the end of a sentence gently asks for agreement. Answers: 好／好啊 or 不好／不行. Similar to 怎麼樣, but 好嗎 is looking for a 'yes'.

modules.title: 車站離這裡遠不遠？
modules.title_py: Chē zhàn lí zhè lǐ yuǎn bù yuǎn?
modules.title_id: Is the station far from here?
modules.scene: Meimei is arriving by train at five. Annie and Dawen estimate the distance to the station from the map, but the walk takes much longer than Dawen said.
can_do: Ask and say distances: A 離 B 遠/近
Say where a journey starts: 從 + place + V
Read a simple map (地圖、街、馬路)
modules.exam_link: Distance & direction are a FREQUENT topic in 聽力 Part 2 and 閱讀 Parts 2–3. Learners often confuse the 離 pattern with 從 — and it becomes a distractor.

lines.zh: 大文，美美幾點到車站？
lines.py: Dà wén, Měi měi jǐ diǎn dào chē zhàn?

lines.zh: 五點。車站離這裡遠不遠？
lines.py: Wǔ diǎn. Chē zhàn lí zhè lǐ yuǎn bù yuǎn?
lines.id: Five. Is the station far from here?

lines.zh: 你看地圖，不遠，很近。
lines.py: Nǐ kàn dì tú, bù yuǎn, hěn jìn.
lines.id: Look at the map: it's not far, it's very close.

lines.zh: 從這裡走路要多久？
lines.py: Cóng zhè lǐ zǒu lù yào duō jiǔ?
lines.id: How long does it take to walk from here?

lines.zh: 十分鐘吧。
lines.py: Shí fēn zhōng ba.
lines.id: About ten minutes.

lines.zh: 那我們四點半離開，好嗎？
lines.py: Nà wǒ men sì diǎn bàn lí kāi, hǎo ma?
lines.id: Then let's leave at four thirty, OK?

lines.zh: 我們走了二十分鐘，車站呢？
lines.py: Wǒ men zǒu le èr shí fēn zhōng, chē zhàn ne?
lines.id: We've been walking for twenty minutes. Where's the station?

lines.zh: 先生，請問車站離這裡遠嗎？
lines.py: Xiān shēng, qǐng wèn chē zhàn lí zhè lǐ yuǎn ma?
lines.id: Excuse me, sir, is the station far from here?

lines.zh: 不遠。你們從這條街走，過馬路就是車站。
lines.py: Bù yuǎn. Nǐ men cóng zhè tiáo jiē zǒu, guò mǎ lù jiù shì chē zhàn.

lines.zh: 大文，你說很近！
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ shuō hěn jìn!
lines.id: Dawen, you said it was close!

lines.zh: 哪有很遠？只有二十分鐘！
lines.py: Nǎ yǒu hěn yuǎn? Zhǐ yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng!
lines.id: Who says it's far? It's only twenty minutes!

lines.zh: 快走吧，美美在等我們！
lines.py: Kuài zǒu ba, Měi měi zài děng wǒ men!

grammar.explain: 從 + place before a verb = starting from / by way of that place: 從這裡走 (go from here), 從這條街走 (go along this street).

examples.id: From here it's a ten-minute walk.
Along this street.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 14
note: 從 + starting point, 到 + destination: 她從日本到馬來西亞. Asking the starting point: 你從公司去嗎? → 不，我從家裡去.

grammar.point: A 離 B — the distance of A from B
grammar.pattern: A + 離 + B + (很)遠/近 ／ 多遠？
grammar.explain: 離 expresses the DISTANCE between two places (not the direction of movement): 車站離這裡很近. To ask: 遠不遠？ or 多遠？ Don't use 從 for distance (車站從這裡很近 ✗).

examples.id: The campus isn't far from the station.
How far is the campus from the station?

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 19
note: Asking: A 離 B 遠不遠? → 很近 / 不遠 / 不太遠 / 有一點遠 / 很遠. 不太遠 = 不怎麼遠.
One place can be measured against two others: 小明家離學校很近，離小華家很遠.

core.meaning: rhetorical 'where': 哪有…！= no way / there's no such thing
core.note: This 義項 = rhetorical (not the question word 'which' from A02).

modules.title: 往前走，到路口右轉。
modules.title_py: Wǎng qián zǒu, dào lù kǒu yòu zhuǎn.
modules.title_id: Go straight ahead and turn right at the junction.
modules.scene: Dawen asks the way to the new library. That evening Meimei calls to check that he got home — it turns out Dawen went home via the night market.
can_do: Understand step-by-step directions: 往前走、到路口右轉、經過…
Express the direction of movement: 從…往…
Say where an action ends up: V到／V在 (走到、放在)
modules.exam_link: Step-by-step directions are a typical 聽力 Part 3 question ('at which junction do you turn?') and appear in 閱讀 Part 3.

lines.zh: 小姐，請問，圖書館怎麼走？
lines.py: Xiǎo jiě, qǐng wèn, tú shū guǎn zěn me zǒu?
lines.id: Excuse me, miss, how do I get to the library?

lines.zh: 你從這裡往前走，到路口向右轉。
lines.py: Nǐ cóng zhè lǐ wǎng qián zǒu, dào lù kǒu xiàng yòu zhuǎn.
lines.id: From here go straight ahead, and turn right at the junction.

lines.zh: 第一個路口嗎？
lines.py: Dì yī ge lù kǒu ma?
lines.id: The first junction?

lines.zh: 不是，第二個十字路口。你會經過一個公園。
lines.py: Bú shì, dì èr ge shí zì lù kǒu. Nǐ huì jīng guò yí ge gōng yuán.
lines.id: No, the second crossroads. You'll pass a park.

lines.zh: 我走到公園，就往右轉，對嗎？
lines.py: Wǒ zǒu dào gōng yuán, jiù wǎng yòu zhuǎn, duì ma?
lines.id: So when I get to the park, I turn right, right?

lines.zh: 對，圖書館在公園對面。
lines.py: Duì, tú shū guǎn zài gōng yuán duì miàn.
lines.id: Right, the library is across from the park.

lines.zh: 大文，你回到家了嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ huí dào jiā le ma?
lines.id: Dawen, did you get home?

lines.zh: 回到了！可是我回家的路走錯了。
lines.py: Huí dào le! Kě shì wǒ huí jiā de lù zǒu cuò le.
lines.id: Yes! But I took the wrong way home.

lines.zh: 你從圖書館往哪裡走？
lines.py: Nǐ cóng tú shū guǎn wǎng nǎ lǐ zǒu?
lines.id: Which way did you go from the library?

lines.zh: 我往左走，走到夜市，在夜市吃了東西，然後回家。
lines.py: Wǒ wǎng zuǒ zǒu, zǒu dào yè shì, zài yè shì chī le dōng xi, rán hòu huí jiā.
lines.id: I went left, ended up at the night market, ate something there, and then went home.

lines.zh: 你走錯的路很好吃啊！
lines.py: Nǐ zǒu cuò de lù hěn hǎo chī a!
lines.id: Your wrong way was delicious!

tasks.why: 十字路口 = crossroads; 右 = right. A: going straight would be 往前走. C: turning left would be 往左轉.

tasks.why: (1) 往前 = forward. (2) 經過 = to pass by. (3) 走到 = to walk as far as. 回 doesn't fit.

tasks.instr: Read these directions, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 從學校往東走，經過一個十字路口，就看到公園。從公園往北走五分鐘，就到車站。
tasks.question: 去車站，在公園要往哪邊走？
tasks.why: 從公園往北走 → you reach the station. A: 往東 is the way from the school to the park. C & D: not mentioned.

grammar.pattern: 從 + place + 往 + direction + V
grammar.explain: 往 + direction before a verb = to move in that direction (往前、往右、往北). With 從 in front for the starting point: 從這裡往前走.

examples.id: From here go straight ahead.
From the park walk north for five minutes.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 14, 19
note: A typical order of directions: 往前走 → 過兩條馬路 → 到了第三個路口往左轉. 到了 can be replaced by 在: 在第三個路口往左轉。
從 A 到 B = from A to B: 從我家到學校走路十分鐘。
Choose 來 or 去 from the speaker's position: 他到學校去 (the speaker is not at school), 他到臺灣來 (the speaker is in Taiwan).
Distance: A 離 B + 很遠 / 不遠 / 有一點遠: 車站離這裡不遠。

grammar.explain: 到/在 right after a verb shows where the action ENDS UP: 走到公園 (walk to the park), 回到宿舍 (get back to the dorm), 放在桌子上 (put on the table), 住在臺北.

examples.id: I walk to the park and then turn right.

examples.zh: 我的新書放在桌子上了。
examples.id: I've put my new books on the table.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 13–14, 29
note: V在 + place shows where something ends up (住、坐、放、停): 我住在臺北。 書放在桌子上。
V到 + place = reaching that place by moving, often closed with 來/去: 他走到學校去了。 小狗跑到這裡來了。

modules.title: 從臺北到臺中怎麼去？
modules.title_py: Cóng Tái běi dào Tái zhōng zěn me qù?
modules.title_id: How do you get from Taipei to Taichung?
modules.scene: Meimei is going home to Taichung this weekend and invites Dawen. They discuss how to get there; in Taichung, Meimei's father picks them up, and in the afternoon they cycle to the park.
can_do: Give a route: 從 A 到 B
Say which way you go: 從 + road + 走
Compare vehicles: 巴士、汽車、腳踏車、騎
modules.exam_link: Comparing means of transport & travel times is a FREQUENT question in 聽力 Part 3 and 閱讀 Part 5 ('which is the fastest?').

lines.zh: 美美，從臺北到臺中怎麼去？
lines.py: Měi měi, cóng Tái běi dào Tái zhōng zěn me qù?
lines.id: Meimei, how do you get from Taipei to Taichung?

lines.zh: 你可以坐火車，也可以坐巴士。巴士比較便宜。
lines.py: Nǐ kě yǐ zuò huǒ chē, yě kě yǐ zuò bā shì. Bā shì bǐ jiào pián yi.
lines.id: You can take the train, or you can take the bus. The bus is cheaper.

lines.zh: 巴士要多久？
lines.py: Bā shì yào duō jiǔ?
lines.id: How long does the bus take?

lines.zh: 兩個多小時。巴士從這條路走，很方便。
lines.py: Liǎng ge duō xiǎo shí. Bā shì cóng zhè tiáo lù zǒu, hěn fāng biàn.
lines.id: Two hours and a bit. The bus goes along this road; it's very convenient.

lines.zh: 到了臺中，我怎麼去你家？
lines.py: Dào le Tái zhōng, wǒ zěn me qù nǐ jiā?
lines.id: When I get to Taichung, how do I get to your house?

lines.zh: 我爸爸開汽車來車站接我們。我家有兩臺汽車。
lines.py: Wǒ bà ba kāi qì chē lái chē zhàn jiē wǒ men. Wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng tái qì chē.
lines.id: My dad will drive to the station to pick us up. My family has two cars.

lines.zh: 美美，你爸爸來接我們，謝謝他！
lines.py: Měi měi, nǐ bà ba lái jiē wǒ men, xiè xie tā!
lines.id: Meimei, your dad came to pick us up; please thank him!

lines.zh: 不客氣。下午我們騎腳踏車去公園吧！
lines.py: Bú kè qì. Xià wǔ wǒ men qí jiǎo tà chē qù gōng yuán ba!
lines.id: You're welcome. This afternoon let's cycle to the park!

lines.zh: 好！從你家到公園遠嗎？
lines.py: Hǎo! Cóng nǐ jiā dào gōng yuán yuǎn ma?
lines.id: OK! Is the park far from your house?

lines.zh: 不遠，從這條小路騎十分鐘就到。
lines.py: Bù yuǎn, cóng zhè tiáo xiǎo lù qí shí fēn zhōng jiù dào.
lines.id: Not far; it's ten minutes by bike along this little road.

lines.zh: 你看，那部巴士好大！公共汽車也到公園嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, nà bù bā shì hǎo dà! Gōng gòng qì chē yě dào gōng yuán ma?
lines.id: Look, that bus is so big! Does the public bus go to the park too?

lines.zh: 到，可是公共汽車的司機開得很快，騎腳踏車比較好玩。
lines.py: Dào, kě shì gōng gòng qì chē de sī jī kāi de hěn kuài, qí jiǎo tà chē bǐ jiào hǎo wán.
lines.id: Yes, but the bus drivers drive really fast; cycling is more fun.

grammar.point: V + 進/出/上/回 + 來/去 — compound directions
grammar.pattern: V + direction (進/出/上/下/回) + 來/去
grammar.explain: A direction word (進 in, 出 out, 上 up, 回 back) + 來 (towards the speaker) / 去 (away): 回來 (come back here), 回去 (go back there), 放進來 (put in here), 走出去 (walk out).

check.q: You're indoors and your friend is outside: 'Come in!'

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 28
note: Full pattern V + 上/下/進/出/回/過 + 來/去: 跑上來・跑上去、搬下來・搬下去、走進來・走進去、開出來・開出去、帶回來・帶回去、送過來・送過去.
起 only pairs with 來: 站起來、拿起來、掛起來 (✗ 站起去).
It also works without 來/去 when the place is named: 走上樓、走進房間、跑出門、走回家.

grammar.pattern: V + 過來 (over here) ／ 過去 (over there)
grammar.explain: 過來 = to cross over towards the speaker; 過去 = to cross over away from them: 走過去 (walk over there), 拿過來 (bring it over here).

grammar.point: (是)…的 — stressing details of a past event
grammar.pattern: S + 是 + when/how/with whom + V + 的
grammar.explain: When the event is already known to have happened, 是…的 is used to ask about/stress its DETAILS: when, where, how, with whom. Negative: 不是…的. 是 can be dropped in positive sentences.

examples.id: I came last September.

examples.zh: 我是跟我姊姊一起來的。
examples.id: I came with my older sister.

check.q: Asking how someone came (it has happened):

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 18
note: 是…的 is only for events that have ALREADY happened; it stresses when, how, where or with whom: 你是怎麼來的？ — 我是坐公車來的。
The negative is 不是…的: 我不是坐飛機來的。 In positive sentences 是 can be dropped: 我坐公車來的。
Tell apart 還是 (choice questions: 你坐火車還是坐公車？) and 或是 (statements: 坐火車或是坐公車都可以。).

grammar.explain: 了 right after a verb = the action is COMPLETE, usually followed by a specific amount/object: 住了三天, 看了很多地方, 坐了五個小時. Different from sentence-final 了 (B09), which marks a change of state.

examples.zh: 我去了三天，看了很多地方。
examples.id: I went for three days and saw lots of places.
Stayed four days in Tainan.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 17, 21
note: V了 + amount/duration for a finished action: 我昨天坐了四十分鐘的車。 Habits (每天) take no 了: 我每天坐四十分鐘的車。
V了 + amount + 了 (two 了) = up to now and still going on: 我學了兩年中文了。
了 at the end of a sentence can also mark a change of state: 他胖了。 我會說中文了。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 15
note: 以為 = to (wrongly) think: 我以為他是日本人，其實他是韓國人。
Pattern 以為…，沒想到… = thought …, but unexpectedly …: 我以為臺北的冬天不冷，沒想到這麼冷。

grammar.pattern: S + 一 + V1，(S) + 就 + V2
grammar.explain: Two events that follow each other very quickly: 一 before the first event, 就 before the second. Also for habits: 我一下課就回家 (whenever class ends I go straight home).

examples.id: As soon as you get out, you can see the sea!

examples.zh: 我一看到這片海，就很高興。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 25
note: It also works for two events that happen to follow each other: 他一到家，就下雨了 (as soon as he got home, it started raining).
For an "every time" habit: 家樂一有機會，就練習中文.

grammar.point: V下來／V下去 — down / to stop
grammar.pattern: V + 下來 (down, towards/stopping) ／ 下去 (down, away)
grammar.explain: 下來/下去 after a verb = moving down: 走下去 (go down there), 坐下來 (sit down). 下來 also often means 'to stop/settle' after moving.

examples.id: Let's go down there.

examples.zh: 我們坐下來休息一下吧。
examples.id: Let's sit down and rest for a bit.

check.q: The teacher at the front says to a standing student: 'Please sit down.'

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 28
note: 下 + 來/去 follows the speaker: 請下來 (come down here — speaker is below); 他下去了 (he went down — speaker is above). 坐下 = 坐下來 = sit down.

modules.scene: Dawen wants to send a letter and some tea to his mother in Indonesia. He borrows Meimei's pen, asks where the post office is, then sends the parcel.

lines.zh: 要，我要去拿錢。銀行幾點開？

lines.id: Hello, excuse me, how much is it to send a letter to Indonesia?

lines.zh: 四十塊。
lines.py: Sì shí kuài.
lines.id: Forty.

lines.zh: 這裡可以買郵票嗎？
lines.py: Zhè lǐ kě yǐ mǎi yóu piào ma?
lines.id: Can I buy stamps here?

lines.zh: 可以。你還要寄別的東西嗎？
lines.py: Kě yǐ. Nǐ hái yào jì bié de dōng xi ma?
lines.id: Yes. Is there anything else you want to send?

lines.zh: 還要寄這個茶給我媽媽。
lines.py: Hái yào jì zhè ge chá gěi wǒ mā ma.
lines.id: I also want to send this tea to my mom.

lines.zh: 好，一共三百二十塊。
lines.py: Hǎo, yí gòng sān bǎi èr shí kuài.
lines.id: OK, that's three hundred and twenty altogether.

lines.zh: 謝謝！我媽媽一定很高興。
lines.py: Xiè xie! Wǒ mā ma yí dìng hěn gāo xìng.
lines.id: Thank you! My mom will be really happy.

modules.title: 我的錢包不見了！怎麼辦？
modules.title_py: Wǒ de qián bāo bú jiàn le! Zěn me bàn?
modules.title_id: My wallet's gone! What shall I do?
modules.scene: At the bus stop Dawen realizes his wallet is missing. Meimei helps him remember when he last used it; that evening they go back to the grilled-meat stall at the night market — and the wallet is there.
can_do: Report lost things: 不見了、掉了
Describe something that happened to you with 被 (被人拿了)
Ask for advice when you don't know what to do: 怎麼辦？
modules.exam_link: Lost items & asking for help SOMETIMES appear in 聽力 Parts 2–3. 被 sentences test who did it and who was affected.

lines.zh: 美美，我的錢包不見了！怎麼辦？
lines.py: Měi měi, wǒ de qián bāo bú jiàn le! Zěn me bàn?
lines.id: Meimei, my wallet's gone! What shall I do?

lines.zh: 你先坐下來。你的錢包掉在哪裡？
lines.py: Nǐ xiān zuò xià lái. Nǐ de qián bāo diào zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Sit down first. Where did you drop your wallet?

lines.zh: 我不知道。可能掉在公車上，也可能被別人拿走了。
lines.py: Wǒ bù zhī dào. Kě néng diào zài gōng chē shàng, yě kě néng bèi bié rén ná zǒu le.
lines.id: I don't know. Maybe on the bus, or maybe someone took it.

lines.zh: 你最後一次用錢包，是什麼時候？
lines.py: Nǐ zuì hòu yí cì yòng qián bāo, shì shén me shí hòu?
lines.id: When did you last use your wallet?

lines.zh: 昨天晚上，在夜市買烤肉。
lines.py: Zuó tiān wǎn shàng, zài yè shì mǎi kǎo ròu.
lines.id: Last night, buying grilled meat at the night market.

lines.zh: 我們先打電話給銀行，然後去夜市問一下。
lines.py: Wǒ men xiān dǎ diàn huà gěi yín xíng, rán hòu qù yè shì wèn yí xià.
lines.id: Let's call the bank first, then go and ask at the night market.

lines.zh: 老闆，請問，你看見一個黑色的錢包嗎？
lines.py: Lǎo bǎn, qǐng wèn, nǐ kàn jiàn yí ge hēi sè de qián bāo ma?
lines.id: Boss, excuse me, have you seen a black wallet?

lines.zh: 有！昨天你的錢包掉在地上，在火的旁邊！我拿給你。
lines.py: Yǒu! Zuó tiān nǐ de qián bāo diào zài dì shàng, zài huǒ de páng biān! Wǒ ná gěi nǐ.
lines.id: Yes! Yesterday your wallet fell on the ground, right next to the fire! I'll get it for you.

lines.zh: 太好了！謝謝老闆！
lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Xiè xie lǎo bǎn!
lines.id: Great! Thank you, boss!

lines.zh: 以後你的錢包要放在背包裡！
lines.py: Yǐ hòu nǐ de qián bāo yào fàng zài bēi bāo lǐ!
lines.id: From now on, keep your wallet in your backpack!

grammar.explain: 被 makes a passive sentence: what is affected comes first, the doer after 被, then the verb (usually + 了). Often used for unpleasant events: 錢包被人拿了. The doer can be left out: 被拿了.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 33
note: Three ways to tell the same event: 小貓弄髒了我的大衣 (plain) / 我的大衣被小貓弄髒了 (被) / 小貓把我的大衣弄髒了 (把).
If the doer is unknown, 被 goes straight to the verb: 他的腳踏車被偷了 (his bike was stolen — nobody knows by whom).

grammar.pattern: S + 為什麼 + VP？ ／ 為什麼？
grammar.explain: 為什麼 asks for the REASON and goes after the subject (it can also go at the start). The answer usually uses 因為… (studied fully in B40). The difference: 怎麼了 = what happened; 為什麼 = why (the reason).

tasks.text: （1）我感冒了，（2）今天不能上課。雖然很累，（3）我明天要考試。
tasks.why: (1)+(2) 因為…所以…. (3) 雖然…但是…. 才 doesn't fit any blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 王大文昨天感冒了，所以今天不能上課。醫生說他要多休息，好了才能去學校。
tasks.question: 大文什麼時候才能去學校？
tasks.why: 好了才能去學校 = can only go to school AFTER getting better (才 = only once the condition is met). A: 今天不能上課. B: 明天 is not mentioned. D: 下課以後 is not mentioned.

grammar.explain: The reason comes first with 因為, the result after it with 所以. In Mandarin both CAN be used together (unlike English, which normally chooses one).

examples.zh: 因為我感冒了，所以今天不能上課。
examples.id: Because I have the flu, I can't come today.

examples.zh: 因為你每天很晚睡覺，所以常常生病。
examples.id: Because you go to bed late every day, you often get ill.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 5
note: The result can come first and the reason after: …，是因為… or …。這是因為…: 我沒去上課，是因為我感冒了。
之所以…，是因為… stresses the reason: 他之所以來臺灣，是因為他想學中文。
由於…，因此… means the same as 因為…，所以… but is more formal (often in writing/news).

grammar.explain: 但是 = but (a little firmer/more formal than 可是); 不過 is softer. The information after 但是 is usually the more IMPORTANT part — watch for it in 聽力 questions.

examples.zh: 這件衣服很漂亮，但是太貴了。
examples.id: This top is pretty, but it's too expensive.
A bit better, but I still feel weak.

check.q: 'He's tall, but he can't play basketball' =
options: 他很高，但是不會打籃球。
但是他很高，不會打籃球。
他很高但是，不會打籃球。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 28
note: If the first clause uses 雖然, the second clause MUST have 可是 / 但是 / 不過: 雖然很貴，可是很好吃。
雖然 can start the sentence or follow the subject: 雖然他很忙… = 他雖然很忙…

catatan.point: 才 and 就 — later or sooner than expected
catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 26
note: 就 = sooner/earlier/easier than expected: 他八點半就來了。 才 = later/harder than expected: 他十點才來。
Sentences with 就 usually end in 了, sentences with 才 do not: 他昨天就回家了。 / 他今天才回家。
才 + number = the speaker feels the number is small: 現在才八點 (it's still early).

catatan.point: 再 — for what has not happened yet
catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 3
note: 再 is for plans that have NOT happened yet: 我明天再來。 才 is for what HAS happened, later than expected: 他昨天十點才來。

core.note: "But" — neutral and firm; pairs with 雖然: 雖然很忙，但是…
Means the same as 但是, but softer and more colloquial: 好一點了，不過還很累。

grammar.pattern: S + 跟 + person + 說/聊/借…
grammar.explain: 跟 + person before a verb of communication marks WHO you are talking to: 跟她說 (tell her), 跟安妮說話 (talk to Annie). (跟1 in B35 = together with.)

grammar.explain: 雖然 introduces what is admitted, 可是/但是 brings in the contrasting fact. In Mandarin both are used together (English normally uses only one). 雖然 can be dropped.

examples.zh: 雖然我說了對不起，可是她還很生氣。
examples.id: Although I've apologised, she's still angry.

options: 雖然很便宜，可是不好吃。
可是很便宜，雖然不好吃。
雖然很便宜不好吃可是。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 28
note: If the first clause uses 雖然, the second clause MUST have 可是/但是/不過 — it cannot be left out.
雖然 can go at the very start or after the subject: 雖然他很喜歡狗，可是… = 他雖然很喜歡狗，可是…

grammar.explain: 出 after a verb = the direction OUT: 拿出 (to take out), 走出 (to walk out). The place of origin usually takes 從: 從書包裡拿出….

note: 出 also combines with 來/去: 拿出來、走出去. 出門 = go out (of the house): 她出門去買東西.

grammar.point: VP 的 N — the N that …
grammar.explain: The relative clause goes BEFORE 的 and the noun (the opposite of English 'that/who' after the noun): 我喜歡的人 = the person I like; 她昨天買的書 = the book she bought yesterday.

note: To point out a person by what they wear or do: 戴眼鏡的那位小姐是我老師; 唱歌的這個孩子是她女兒. 著 can be added: 戴(著)眼鏡的.
Asking who did it: 這個菜是誰做的? → 是我做的. Jobs can also be named with VP的: 我是教書的、她是賣花的 (see C67).

grammar.pattern: S + 看起來/聽起來 + Vs
grammar.explain: 看起來 = looks (from appearance), 聽起來 = sounds (from what is heard). They express an impression, not a certain fact.

examples.id: You look nervous.
What you say sounds right.

check.q: Your friend tells you about holiday plans: 'Sounds fun!'

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 1
note: V起來 + judgment = an IMPRESSION from the senses: 聞起來很香 (it smells nice), 喝起來很好喝, 看起來…, 聽起來…
Two senses can be combined: 這種茶聞起來很香，喝起來也很好喝.

grammar.pattern: Vs + N ／ 很 Vs + 的 + N
grammar.explain: One-syllable adjectives attach directly: 好學生, 新書. If the adjective has 很 or is longer, 的 is REQUIRED: 很好的學生, 很用功的學生.

examples.zh: 他是一個很用功的學生。

core.meaning: (adverbial particle: Vs + 地 + V, e.g. 高興地說)

grammar.explain: 又 = again, for something that HAS been repeated (usually with 了): 我又去了. For 'again' in the future use 再: 我明年再去.

grammar.explain: 又 before a negative word stresses a rebuttal, often with the tone of 'but I'm not …, you know!': 我又不是老師 (I'm not a teacher, you know!). Meaning: don't expect me to know/be able to.

options: But I've never been to Japan!

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 23
note: 又不/又沒 rebut with an 'obvious' reason: 我又不是韓國人，我怎麼會說? (I'm not Korean, how would I know?); 那部電影又沒有什麼內容，我不想去看.
Compare: 並不/並沒 = calmly correcting what others assume (她並不是韓國人); 可不/可沒 = strong 'not me!' (我可沒抽菸).

grammar.explain: Mandarin often puts the TOPIC (what is being talked about) first, then the comment: 這本書我看過 (this book, I've read). An object that becomes the topic moves to the front.

examples.id: I've read this book — it's good.

grammar.explain: 沒(有) denies that something HAPPENED/was done (usually in the past): 我昨天沒上課. 不, on the other hand, denies habits, wishes or the future: 我不上課 (I don't/won't go to class). There is no 了 after 沒.

grammar.explain: 就 before a verb stresses immediacy or determination: 明年就來 (coming as soon as next year — sooner than you'd expect), 就去臺灣！ (right, Taiwan it is!).

examples.zh: 我決定了，就去臺灣念書！

She's coming as soon as next year.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 26
note: 就 = EARLIER/sooner than expected, usually with 了: 我們公司九點上班，李先生八點半就來了. The opposite is 才 = later, WITHOUT 了: 王先生九點十分才來.
Fixed pairs: 就…了 and 才…的: 他們去年就搬到鄉下去了 / 他們昨天才搬到鄉下去的.
